_doc: Registry of live / finished eval generation runs (Alloy stages, later Stage 2/3 campaigns) for the dashboard's Eval manifest page. Each entry points at a status JSON written by the run's launcher (e.g. STAGE1_alloy/models/proposed_twophase/launch_stage1.py). Paths are as seen INSIDE the cafe2 gem5_dev container, where the dashboard runs; on another host the page shows the entry as 'status not available here'. Human view: wiki/state/EVAL_MANIFEST.md.

runs.config: 52 partitions (exact size k=1..6 x transmitter kind, partition_stage1.py), 48 parallel, cap 200000 per partition, timeout 24 h, -Xmx8g

runs.stage: Stage 1.5 (pin each core into the production model, exactly 6 instructions)
runs.started: 2026-11-09T01:54Z (restarted 01:56Z with 24 jobs + serial GC after contention)
runs.config: ~300,000 instances per family (Anna 2026-11-08) split evenly over its cores (per-core cap = ceil(300000/cores)); one seeded production-model run per core; 24 parallel; 30 min per core; JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS=-XX:+UseSerialGC -XX:CICompilerCount=2; each family starts when its Stage 1 is complete
runs.results: <ws>/s15/<family>/results.jsonl (one line per core) + out/<part>__<inst>/; dedup + renumber into a testset is the next step (merge)
